source: 752 In the Darkness
target: 752 In Tenebris

source: 752 In the Darkness
target: 752 In Tenebris

source: Dammit!
target: Heu!

source: Though Lumian had toyed with the idea of taking risks, he hadn’t truly made up his mind.
target: Quamquam Lumian de consilio pericula capiendi luserat, veram autem sententiam nondum decreverat.

source: The sudden extinguishing of his white candle prompted him to swear under his breath, instinctively preparing to activate the black mark on his shoulder and teleport out of the catacombs.
target: Subitus exstinguens candelae albae suae eum impulit ut sub ore iuraret, instinctive parans ut in umero suo atrum sigillum activaret et e catacumbis evaderet.

source: At that moment, a bone-chilling cold tinged with slight pain surged through the palm of his right hand.
target: Illo momento, frigore ossa terrente, cum parvo dolore tincto, per palmam dextrae eius inruit.

source: This snap of pain brought him to his senses, thankfully without any further unpleasant changes to his body.
target: Hic ictus doloris eum ad sensum revocavit, gratias Deo quod nulla ulterius incommoda mutationes corporis factae sunt.

source: Indeed… Lumian instantly calmed down, abandoning the idea of using his Spirit World Traversal ability.
target: Revera… Lumian statim se tranquillavit, consilium uti facultate transitus in Mundi Spirituum desinens.

source: His suspicions were confirmed!
target: Suspicionēs eius confirmatae sunt!

source: He clenched his right hand discreetly, ensuring the prominently-marked Underworld Daoist seal wasn’t visible to anything lurking in the darkness.
target: Manum dextram caute comprimentem curavit, ut sigillum Daoisticum Inferorum insigniter notatum a quolibet in tenebris latentibus non videaretur.

source: After the elderly, decaying, and clearly unwell catacombs administrator mistook him for a kindred spirit, Lumian suspected it was due to the Underworld Daoist seal.
target: Postquam senex, putrescens, atque manifeste infirmus administrator catacumbarum eum pro cognato spiritu equivocavit, Lumian suspicatus est id ob sigillum Daoisticum Inferorum esse.

source: Given that the Samaritan Women’s Spring was closely related to the Underworld Daoist and the catacombs of Trier were likely built to contain its overflowing influence, the administrators took turns guarding the massive tomb chamber leading to the spring.
target: Cum Fons Mulierum Samaritarum arcte coniungeretur cum Daoisticis Inferorum, et catacumbae Treverenses verisimiliter ad eius effusam potentiam continendam aedificatae essent, administratores vicissim in magna cella sepulcrali, quae ad fontem ducebat, custodiendum munere se tradiderunt.

source: Since catacombs administrators affected by anomalies could navigate the dark catacombs without a lit white candle and not disappear, theoretically, he should be able to as well, given his Underworld Daoist seal!
target: Cum administratores catacumbarum, anomaliebus affecti, per tenebrosas catacumbas sine candela alba accensa navigare et non evanescere poterant, theoretice et ipse id efficere debet, propter sigillum Daoisticum Inferorum suum!

source: Of course, this was extremely risky. A wrong guess could mean dying without leaving a trace, causing Lumian to hesitate despite his wild impulse.
target: Certe, hoc erat summopere periculosum. Errata coniectura mortem sine vestigio relinquere poterat, quod Lumian, non obstante impetu ferocio, ad dubitationem adducebat.

source: In the pure darkness, where his eyes saw nothing, Lumian felt as if he were in Trier’s subterranean river, immersed in cold, damp, heavy, and silent waters.
target: In pura tenebris, ubi oculi eius nihil videbant, Lumian se sensit quasi in flumine subterraneo Treverensi esset, in aquis frigidis, humidis, gravibus et tacitis immersus.

source: Yet, he breathed easily; his body and soul strangely drawing air from the dense, dark “waters,” sustaining his existence.
target: At tamen facile spirabat; corpus et anima eius mirabiliter aerem ex aquis densis et obscuris trahentes, vitam suam sustentabant.

source: He seemed like a fish in the deep sea.
target: Velut piscis in profundo mari videbatur.

source: The darkness, like flowing water, layered and pressed down, isolating this space from the surrounding areas and the outside world.
target: Tenebrae, vel aquae fluentes, se stratis disposuerunt et premebant, spatium hoc a circumstantiis et mundo externo segregantes.

source: The next moment, Lumian heard the old administrator’s raspy, indifferent voice.
target: Proximo momento, Lumian vocem asperam et indifferenter sonantem senis administratoris audivit.

source: “Recently, three people tried to approach the spring, but I stopped them.”
target: “Nuper tres homines fontem appropinquare conati sunt, sed ego eos prohibui.”

source: Three people… Lumian’s spirit lifted as he asked, “Who were they?”
target: Tres homines… Animus Lumiani surrexit, dum quaerebat: “Qui erant illi?”

source: “One time it was a Blessed of darkness and death with a Hunter,” the old administrator described in his own way.
target: “Olim fuit Beatus tenebrarum et mortis cum Venatore,” senex administrator suo modo descripsit.

source: A Blessed of darkness and death with a Hunter.. Isn’t that Madame Hela and me? You still remember us… Lumian realized, followed by muttered criticisms.
target: Beatus tenebrarum et mortis cum Venatore… Nonne illa est Domina Hela atque ego? Nos adhuc meministis… Lumian intellexit, et secuta sunt murmurationes leviter reprehensivae.

source: He had thought this elderly administrator, unlike the more active ones like Kendall and nearing a corpse-like state, didn’t recognize people by sight but by sensing their presence— Lumian had encountered two catacombs administrators guiding visitors when he arrived at the Entrance to the Old Ossuary, and they didn’t see him as one of their own. Instead, they advised him not to wander alone and always keep a white candle burning for light.
target: Existimaverat senem administratoris, dissimilem activioribus ut Kendall, qui ad mortuosam similitudinem accedere videbatur, homines non per aspectum sed per praesentiam eorum agnoscere; Lumian enim duos administratores catacumbarum, qui visitores ducebant, convenisse meminit, cum ad Introitum Veteris Ossuarii pervenisset, et illi eum non inter suos agnoverunt. Immo, moniti sunt ne solus errarent atque ut semper candela alba pro lumine arderet.

source: “Who was the third?” Lumian pressed on.
target: “Quis tertius erat?” inquit Lumian.

source: Was it Harrison, or Monette, the incarnation of Amon active in these subterranean catacombs?
target: Fuitne Harrison, an Monette, incarnatio Amonis, quae in his catacumbis subterraneis operatur?

source: The old catacombs administrator responded in a monotone, husky voice, “An outsider, he felt similar to us but also different, so I stopped him.”
target: Senex administrator catacumbarum respondit voce monotona et rauca: “Alienus est; similis nobis se videbat, sed etiam diversus, ideo eum prohibui.”

source: Similar yet different… an outsider… Lumian pondered these key descriptions and surmised it was probably Harrison from Resurrection Island!
target: Similis sed diversus… alienus… Lumian his descriptionibus meditatus est et coniectus, fortasse, esse Harrison ex Insula Resurrectionis!

source: “What did he look like?” Lumian asked, controlling his emotions, seemingly calm.
target: “Quomodo ille videbatur?” inquit Lumian, affectus suos temperans et tranquillum apparens.

source: He couldn’t see through the darkness, not even the outline of the old administrator, but he sensed the other was right in front of him, no more than two meters away.
target: Per tenebras videre non potuit, ne formam quidem senis administratoris, sed sensit illum statim ante se esse, non longius quam duo metra distantem.

source: He then heard the old administrator reply: “I’ve been an administrator for so long, I’ve forgotten many things. Even death itself vanishes here, let alone our memories. I can’t remember what he looked like, only that he didn’t resemble an Intisian, nor a Loenese or Feysacian.”
target: Tum senex administrator respondit: “Tamdiu administravi ut multa oblitus sim; etiam mors ipsa hic evanescit, nedum memoriae nostrae. Non memini quomodo ille videbatur, nisi quod neque Intisianus, neque Loenensis, neque Feysacianus ei similis fuit.”

source: After a brief pause, the catacombs administrator continued in his flat tone, “I should go back to rest now…”
target: Post brevem moram, administrator catacumbarum in tono aequo continuavit: “Nunc ad quiescendum redire debeo…”

source: Lumian did not try to stop him, nor did he ask further questions.
target: Lumian neque eum prohibere conatus est neque ulteriores quaestiones posuit.

source: Although he hadn’t heard any footsteps, nor sensed any movement ahead, a very clear thought suddenly struck him: The person has already left.
target: Quamquam vestigia graduum non audivit nec motus aliquos ante sensit, repente clarum ei pervenit: persona iam discessit.

source: He didn’t look like an Intisian, a Loenese, or a Feysacian… An outsider… Someone who had been to the fourth level of the catacombs in recent months… Lumian replayed the catacombs administrator’s responses in his mind over and over.
target: Non videbatur ut Intisianus, aut Loenensis, aut Feysacianus… alienus… aliquis qui ad quartum gradum catacumbarum nuper pervenerat… Lumian responsa administratoris catacumbarum in mente sua iteravit rursus atque rursus.

source: Suddenly, he remembered something: Franca had mentioned that she encountered a man in the catacombs who she suspected came from the world of the Celestial Master—the world they had transmigrated from. Her judgment was based on the man’s appearance, which closely resembled the people from that world and was distinctly different from those of the Intisians, Loenese, Feynapotterians, and Feysacians!
target: Subito, aliquid memoravit: Franca dixit se virum in catacumbis convenisse, quem suspicabatur ex mundo Magistri Caelestis esse – eo mundo unde translati fuerant. Iudicium eius in specie viri fundabatur, quae populum illius mundi arcte resemblabat et a Intisianis, Loenensibus, Feynapotterianis, atque Feysacianis distincte differebat.

source: So, the person Franca met was the one the elderly administrator persuaded to leave? And that person could very well be Harrison from Resurrection Island…
target: Ergo, persona quam Franca convenit, fuitne ea qua senex administrator ad discedendum persuaserat? Et iste fortasse Harrison ex Insula Resurrectionis esse potuit…

source: /s Resurrection Island actually a node where two worlds converge?
target: /s Insula Resurrectionis re vera est nodus ubi duo mundi conveniunt?

source: The reason the nautical chart leading to Resurrection Island is incorrect is because it lacks mystical details; even if one reaches the designated sea area, only danger is encountered, with no sight of the goal?
target: Causa cur charta nautica quae ad Insulam Resurrectionis ducit erronea sit, est quod notis mysticis carens est; etsi quis ad aream maritimam designatam perveniat, solum periculum occurrit, nec finis in conspectu apparet?

source: This would nicely explain Franca’s divination result that the “chart is genuine” and why adventurers have failed to locate Resurrection Island. The charts are indeed accurate, but they don’t record the method to open the “Island’s Door”!
target: Hoc bene explicaret eventum divinationis Francae, quae affirmavit “charta vera est,” et cur viatores Insulam Resurrectionis invenire non valuerint. Chartae vere sunt accuratae, sed modum ad aperiendum “Ianuam Insulae” non inscribunt!

source: If this is the case, there should be a deeper explanation for why Franca and the others were transmigrated, and for the purpose of the Resurrection Islanders appearing on the North and South Continents…
target: Si hoc ita sit, explanatio profundior debet esse de causa cur Franca et ceteri translati sint, atque de proposito ut Insulares Resurrectionis in Continenti Septentrionali et Meridionali apparerent…

source: The good thing now is, Franca has seen someone who might be Harrison and has drawn a corresponding portrait through a ritual, which will help us in our future search.
target: Bonum nunc est quod Franca quemque vidit qui fortasse Harrison sit, et per ritum eius imaginem delineavit, quae nobis in futura inquisitione prodesse poterit.

source: Heh heh, Franca and Jenna’s exploration yielded quite a lot of crucial information about many important matters, filled with a sense of being arranged.
target: Heh heh, exploratio Francae et Jennae plurimas informationes cruciales de multis rebus gravibus attulit, sensu apparendi ordinatae.

source: This might not have been that entity’s doing, but it’s highly likely related to Monette, who often haunts this place…
target: Forsitan non huius entitatis munus fuit, sed verisimiliter pertinet ad Monette, quae hunc locum saepe infestat…

source: Lumian was particularly puzzled about why the True Creator or Amon valued this matter so much. Their previous “help” was mainly about combating the evil gods beyond the barrier and didn’t involve issues from another world.
target: Lumian maxime miratus est cur Verus Creator aut Amon hanc rem tam magno pretio aestimarent. Praevius eorum “auxilium” praecipue ad deos malos ultra limen pugnandum pertinebat neque ad quaestiones ex alio mundo attinebat.

source: Hmm, would that Celestial Worthy be counted as one of the evil gods beyond the barrier?
target: Hmm, num ille Caelestis Dignus inter malos deos ultra limen numerandus sit?

source: Does He come from the Celestial Master’s world?
target: Venitne ille ex mundo Magistri Caelestis?

source: /s this also considered a part of the evil gods’ invasion?
target: /s num hoc etiam pars invasionis malos deorum habetur?

source: Lumian speculated briefly before pondering another question: Whether to inform Franca, 007, Madame Hela, and other members of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society about this.
target: Lumian breve speculatus est antequam aliam quaestionem meditaret: num Francae, 007, Domina Hela, et ceteris membris Societatis Inquisitionis Papionum Crispatorum haec nuntiare deberent.

source: Lumian could already picture what would happen: Including Franca, some members of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society would desperately set out to sea, searching for Resurrection Island marked on the sea chart, failing to find the island, but finding it being even more dangerous!
target: Lumian iam imaginari poterat quid futurum esset: cum Franca, nonnulli membri Societatis Inquisitionis Papionum Crispatorum ad mare desperanter navigare inciperent, Insulam Resurrectionis in charta nautica notatam quaerentes; insulam invenire non valentes, sed eam magis periculosam reperientes!

source: But Lumian preferred to see Franca remain as she was: conflicted about her gender but generally happy.
target: Sed Lumian mavult videre Francam esse qualis fuit: de genere suo dubiam, sed plerumque laetam.

source: After a moment of silence, Lumian laughed a bit out of character, whispering self-mockingly in the environment like the dark depths of the sea, “Would you avoid seeking a way to resurrect Aurore because of danger and others’ expectations?
target: Post momentum silentii, Lumian aliquantulum extra personam ridebat, sibi ipsi submurmurans in ambitu velut obscuris abyssis maris: “Num viam quaerere ad Aurore resuscitandam ob periculum et exspectationes aliorum vitabis?”

source: “Would you give up resisting because of danger and others’ expectations?
target: “Num propter periculum et exspectationes aliorum resistentiam desereres?”

source: “Would you refuse to merge with the bloodline of Omebella because of danger and others’ expectations?
target: “Num ob periculum et aliorum exspectationes coniunctionem cum sanguine Omebellae recusares?”

source: “No!”
target: “Minime!”

source: Lumian made up his mind and began to focus on his surroundings.
target: Lumian animum constituit et coepit ad circumstantia attendere.

source: He couldn’t see anything but faintly sensed figures wandering in the darkness, felt hands reaching out to him, grabbing his arms, ankles, neck, and body, yet not having any tangible effect.
target: Nulla videri poterat, sed subtiliter figuras in tenebris errantes intuitus est, manus quae ad eum tendebant, brachia, talos, collum, et corpus eius arripiebant, sed nullum palpabilem effectum habebant.

source: No, there was one thing—Lumian felt distinctly colder, to the point where, with the physical traits of a Reaper, he almost couldn’t help but constrict his pores and shiver lightly.
target: Minime, una tamen re: Lumian clare sensit se frigidiorem esse, ita ut, cum proprietatibus Messoris, paene non possent quin poros contraheret et leviter tremorem faceret.

source: He also heard faint, painful, despairing cries but couldn’t discern their specific directions.
target: Etiam audivit voces infimas, dolentes et desperatas, sed earum certas directiones discernere non potuit.

source: Are these the people who vanished in the catacombs before? Lumian tried to listen closely, to find one or two of the missing, to understand their current state, but it was to no avail.
target: Num hi sunt homines qui ante in catacumbis evanuerunt? Lumian diligenter auscultare conatus est, ut unum aut duo ex eis qui aberant reperirent et statum eorum intellexerent, sed frustra.

source: Suddenly, he shivered.
target: Subito, tremuit.

source: The cold and the dead silence seeped into his mind.
target: Frigus et mortua silentia in mentem eius penetraverunt.

source: His thoughts became slightly sluggish, and his memories of certain things grew a bit fuzzy.
target: Cogitationes eius paulo tardiores fiere coeperunt, et memoriae quarundam rerum aliquantulum opacae factae sunt.

source: The Underworld Daoists seal just prevents me from disappearing on the spot, from even dying without a trace, but it can’t stop me from being slowly eroded by the abnormalities here, like those catacombs administrators? And, my erosion is clearly faster than theirs…
target: Sigillum Daoistarum Inferorum mihi tantum impediat ut in loco evanescam, ne mortuus quidem sine vestigio fiam, sed non potest me impediere ut paulatim ab anomaliebus hic corrodear, sicut illi administratores catacumbarum? Et erosio mea certe celerior est quam eorum…

source: Lumian snapped a flame into existence, lighting the white candle in his hand.
target: Lumian flammam creavit, candelae albae in manu sua accendens.

source: The darkness, cold, weight, silence, and dampness retreated as the light spread.
target: Tenebrae, frigus, pondus, silentium et humiditas recederunt dum lux diffundebatur.

source: Lumian glanced at the candle in his hand, nodding and muttering to himself, “I just interpreted the Underworld Daoist’s seal as a kind of alternative white candlelight, but now it seems, they’re not the same, fundamentally different. One stems from an anomaly being sealed, the other leverages the power sealing this place?”
target: Lumian ad candelae in manu sua intuebatur, caput annuens et sibi submurmurans: “Modo sigillum Daoistarum Inferorum tamquam speciem alternativae candelae albae interpretatus sum; sed nunc videtur non eadem esse, sed fundamentaliter diversa. Una ex anomalie sigillata oritur, altera vim ad hoc locum signandum adhibet?”

source: As thoughts swirled, Lumian, holding the burning white candle, made his way back along the original route.
target: Dum cogitationes circumvolabant, Lumian, candela alba ardens tenens, iter originalem retrorsum secutus est.

source: Upon returning to the Entrance of the Old Ossuary, he saw that the few university students who had been there were gone.
target: Revertus ad Introitum Veteris Ossuarii, animadvertit paucos iuvenes universitarios, qui ibi fuerant, discessisse.

source: “Scared off, just like that?” Lumian scoffed softly, leisurely leaving the catacombs and returning to Place du Purgatoire.
target: “Territi, ita?” inquit Lumian leniter subsannans, catacumbas paulatim relinquens et ad Place du Purgatoire rediens.

source: In the Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Apartment 702 on 9 Rue Orosai.
target: In Quartière Cathédralis Commemorativae, Apartmentum 702 in via Orosai numero IX.

source: Franca, who was about to go out to gather information on the Mirror People, saw Lumian again.
target: Franca, quae exire ad de Populo Specularum informationem colligendam parata erat, iterum Lumian vidit.

source: “You’re here again? It’s the third time today!” the Demoness of Pleasure asked, her lips twitching slightly.
target: “Iterum ades? Tertium iam tempore hodie!” inquit Demonissa Voluptatis, labris leviter concitatis.
